description: Premium over spot for a price you were quoted. Give a tracked product slug to also see where the price sits against today's lowest, median and highest listed dealer prices, or give metal and weight for any item.

metal.description: Use with weight_ozt when the item is not a tracked product.

payment.description: Which dealer price list to compare with (tracked products only).

price.description: Price quoted for one item, in USD.

product.description: Tracked product slug or name with its weight (see list_products). A name only matches a product of the same weight.

weight_ozt.description: Pure metal content in troy ounces (use with metal).

name: premium_over_spot
title: Premium over spot checker
